sources.text: CAPI Machine owns infrastructure through an AzureMachine. Control plane initialization precedes worker readiness. The collector writes machine cloud-init logs under artifacts/clusters/{cluster}/machines/{machine}/cloud-init-output.log. artifacts/clusters/{cluster}/machines/{machine}/cloud-init-output.log kubernetes-sigs/cluster-api-provider-azure CAPI AzureMachine MachinePool CAPI Machine reconciliation delegates infrastructure provisioning to AzureMachine resources. Diagnose infrastructure provisioning, bootstrap completion, control plane initialization, then node readiness from timestamped conditions and logs. Jobs select Linux, Windows, and MachinePool templates; identify the actual template from job metadata. After build-log and JUnit, identify the template, inspect Machine and AzureMachine conditions, then read the matching machine bootstrap log. kubernetes-sigs/cluster-api-provider-azure artifacts/clusters/{cluster}/machines/{machine}/cloud-init-output.log Shows bootstrap commands and cloud-init failures for one machine. Bootstrap command failure cloud-init reports a nonzero bootstrap command cloud-init-output.log Machine and AzureMachine conditions Do not infer an Azure API defect from a node readiness timeout alone. Recommend code or template changes only when the failing command and owner are established. Recovered cloud API throttling A timestamped retry succeeds and reconciliation progresses during the run. Throttling persists, credentials are invalid, quota remains exhausted, or reconciliation never progresses.
